name: Bond market volatility
summary: Treasury volatility index MOVE back above 100 at 106 on 20 Nov; US 10-year yield 4.91%, little changed over a month
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility closed near 106 on 20 Nov, up 5% on the week and back above the 100 Watch line after dipping below it on 18–19 Nov (Yahoo Finance). The US 10-year yield ended near 4.91%, about 8bp lower over the month and well inside the 40bp line, having traded near 5.13% on 16 Nov as markets priced a December Fed rise (Trading Economics).
for_you: Swings in US government bond prices feed through to mortgage and borrowing rates. Variable-rate borrowers and bond fund holders are most exposed.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — ICE BofAML MOVE Index
Trading Economics — US 10-Year Treasury Note Yield Edges Down

why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
